core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Generic Drugs; Medical Devices; OTC Healthcare; Parapharmacy
specialty_focus: OCP Répartition is a full-line pharmaceutical wholesale distributor in France, acting as a logistical link between drug laboratories and retail pharmacies and hospital centers. It supplies approximately 14,000 town/city pharmacies and 2,000 hospital pharmacies daily, focusing on supply chain continuity for essential medications and providing pharmacy support services such as digital platforms, equipment sourcing, staff training, and financial solutions for independent pharmacists. While it distributes medical devices and care items, its primary role is as a broadline pharmaceutical distributor, not a specialist in wearable medical devices.
